lines.zh: 我一脚踩下，蘑菇全扁了。
lines.en: One step of mine flattens the mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我肩上长着菌盖，一路掉孢子。
lines.en: Fungal caps grow on my shoulders, shedding spores.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过湿地，泥都陷了。
lines.en: I shift across the wet ground and the mud gives.

lines.zh: 我的手臂扫过一片菌丛。
lines.en: My arm sweeps through a patch of fungus.
Every step of mine lands heavy.

lines.zh: 我身上的菌褶一张一合。
lines.en: The gills on me open and close.

lines.zh: 我停下来，孢子在我周围飘。
lines.en: I stop and spores drift around me.
The flesh on me swells and contracts.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了一朵大的，声音很闷。
lines.en: I crush a big one and it sounds muffled.
I stand while spores fall from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖随着呼吸起伏。
lines.en: My caps rise and fall with my breathing.
The gills on my flank tremble faintly.
My skin is wet and slick.
I'm listening under the mycelium.

lines.zh: 一只虫爬上了我的手臂。
lines.en: A bug climbs onto my arm.

lines.zh: 菌丝在泥里替我摸着路。
lines.en: My mycelium feels the way through the mud.
My gills flare and close like breathing.
Mycelium creeps out from under my feet.

lines.zh: 空气里全是潮湿的味儿。
lines.en: The air is all damp smell.
My caps are slowly growing.
Mycelium stirs on the ground.
My breath comes out warm.
I go quiet again.
You've trampled a patch of fungus.
I raise my head and spores drift your way.

lines.zh: 我身上长的东西会传染。
lines.en: What grows on me spreads.
Stand back — spores drift.
My caps are swelling.

lines.zh: 孢子已经落进你的喉咙。
lines.en: My spores are already in your throat.

lines.zh: 你踩的那片菌毯是我的。
lines.en: The fungal mat under your feet is mine.
You're not covering your mouth.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛埋在菌盖下面。
lines.en: My eyes are buried under the caps.
No hurry; there's plenty of spore here.
You're backing away — I understand.
Everything on the ground is me.

lines.zh: 我闷叫一声，孢子喷出来。
lines.en: I grunt and spores burst out.

lines.zh: 这一下打落了我肩上的菌盖。
lines.en: That knocked a cap off my shoulder.
I step back and the mud parts.
One of my caps has split.
Slime runs down me.

lines.zh: 我一声不出，把身子挺直。
lines.en: I make no sound and straighten up.

lines.zh: 被砍开的地方在慢慢合。
lines.en: The cut is slowly closing.
The mycelium tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 我的孢子在空气里更浓了。
lines.en: My spores are thicker in the air now.
A smell of rot — good.
Can I eat that in your hand?
I pick it up and sniff.
This will rot — I like it.
I press it into my fungal mat.
The smell has spread.
I want some more.

lines.zh: 这么小块，连菌褶都填不满。
lines.en: That scrap won't even fill my gills.
Just leave it there.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，一手的湿。
lines.en: You hit me and your hand comes away wet.
Not a gill of mine shifted.
You stepped on my mycelium.
I turn slowly aside.
My arm brushed you.
Mushrooms grow all over me.
My footing is solid.
I'm sticky; don't touch too much.
I'd rather go around.
I'm the only growth of me here.

lines.zh: 我脚下的菌丝越来越广。
lines.en: The mycelium under me keeps spreading.
I release my spores.
The wind will carry them.
One day something else will grow.
I wait for that day.
There's nothing else like me here.
I extend a fine thread of mycelium.
It touches nothing.
I draw it slowly back.
The stone made me spit it out.
I bite into that fungal cap.
It's slimy in my hands.
The smell stays on my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进肩上的缝里。
lines.en: I tuck it into a gap on my shoulder.
I sniff and press it into the mud.
This will grow on me.

lines.zh: 孢子被你捡走，就别怪菌丝缠脚。
lines.en: You picked up my spores; don't blame the mycelium for snaring your feet.
I raise my head from under the caps.
My spores drift over before I do.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，顺着菌丝来了。
lines.en: Your scent travels down my mycelium.
I've spread my caps widest.
The mycelium on the ground tightens.
I walk toward it, step by step.
It hasn't noticed the spores.
My cap opens; the spores go first.

lines.zh: 你脚下的菌丝已经收紧了。
lines.en: The mycelium at your feet has already tightened.
This whole area is my fungal mat.
The ground under it is soft.
I've closed around it.
It wants to run; it can't run fast.
I've raised my arm.
The mud softens with each step - you can't run.
I've ringed it in the middle of my mat.

lines.zh: 地上的菌丝在它脚边缠。
lines.en: Mycelium coils around its feet.
I raise both arms and spores fall.
It goes left; the mycelium goes left.
I herd it toward the wet ground.
Its feet are sinking in the mud.
I close off the way out.
Spores have settled on it.
My caps open and close.
It's trying to break through the middle.
I put my arm across.

lines.zh: 它退半步，孢子就多一层。
lines.en: It steps back; another layer of spores.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只要把路堵上。
lines.en: I don't chase. I just close the paths.
The air is thick with spores.
Its movements are slowing.
Two steps from it.
I open all my caps.
Each step it takes sinks an inch.
I circle it, closer each lap.
It covers its mouth — too late.
I press it against the rotting wood.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，泥都飞了。
lines.en: My fist comes down and the mud sprays.
My arm sweeps it off its feet.
I grab it and press it down.

lines.zh: 这一下孢子全扬起来了。
lines.en: That threw up every spore.
I throw it into the fungus.
It struggles back up.
I close my hand slowly.
It's pinned in the mud.
The gills on me have opened.
I exhale a cloud of spores.
It sinks into my fungal mat.
My second blow lands in the same spot.

lines.zh: 我的手臂还在滴着黏液。
lines.en: My arm is still dripping slime.

lines.zh: 我从一堆烂木头里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a heap of rotting wood.
The caps spread first, then the rest of me.
My first breath is all spores.
Wet ground and fungus all around.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤还是半透明的。
lines.en: My skin is still half translucent.

lines.zh: 我把脚从烂泥里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull my feet out of the rotten mud.

lines.zh: 肩上有一朵菌在慢慢开。
lines.en: A cap on my shoulder opens slowly.
I bow and spores dust the ground.

lines.zh: 烂木堆底下，菌盖先拱出来。
lines.en: Under the rotten wood, my cap pushes out first.
Insects crawl far off.
My shadow looks sticky.
Mycelium threads out from my feet.
The air here is warm.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖肩膀，孢子成云。
lines.en: I shake my shoulders and spores cloud up.
Mycelium spreads under my feet.
I hear something in the wet soil.
The fungus here all leans toward me.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的菌盖，卷起来了。
lines.en: Fire scorches my caps and they curl.

lines.zh: 我砸在地上，身体散了一块。
lines.en: I hit the ground and a piece of me comes off.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的菌褶，我沉了。
lines.en: Water floods my gills and I sink.

lines.zh: 冲击把我身上的菌盖全掀了。
lines.en: The blast tears every cap off me.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的肩肉里。
lines.en: An arrow sinks into the meat of my shoulder.
A spell is caught in my mycelium.
Nothing rotting to eat; I'm shrinking.

lines.zh: 雷打透了我，孢子全烧了。
lines.en: Lightning goes through me and burns my spores.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我整团坠下去。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I drop whole.
